/api/surveillance/dynamic/summary.disclaimer: The Dynamic Surveillance Engine is a capstone prototype model and is not epidemiologically validated for production public-health decision-making.

description.baseline: Rolling historical mean of the 7 days before the surveillance date (the date itself and later days are never used). Days without data are left out; at least 5 days with data are required. Volume: mean eligible tests per day. Positivity: pooled positives / (positives + negatives).
description.affected_facility_rule: Sufficient own baseline, at least 10 eligible tests, and volume >= +25% or positivity >= +5 percentage points above the facility's own baseline.
description.persistence_rule: Consecutive days, ending on the surveillance date, with at least one abnormal facility, read from the persisted dynamic signal history.
description.eligibility: Mapped test for the syndrome; status final, amended or corrected; active participating facility; outside the frozen demonstration period. Positivity counts Positive and Negative results only.
